_note: Items (SPEC §15.2) and consumables (§15.1). All numbers and prices are placeholders. 'back_attacks': a bow that adds that many attacks from the back row (the Longbow and Stormbow; playtest round 23, in place of the map range they gave). 'use': any, melee (a unit with a Melee attack in either row), archer (the archer tag). Consumables: 'stock' is how many a shop holds when full (refilled at noon); 'where' is map (squad menu, anywhere on the map), battle (the battle view's Items button) or scroll (scrolls, map actions read from the squad menu's Scrolls button: 'weight' is the odds of each from a temple's first liberation and a shop's scroll; Invisibility lasts 'ticks'; Decoy works 'chance' of the time and sends the enemy squad 'hexes' away, to wait 'ticks' after it arrives); a 'cures' potion removes that one status; each shop carries economy.shop_cures of the cure potions, picked once per shop. Items marked rare (round 9: very rare, a big buff) are never rolled for shops, kits or treasure; one random shop per map holds one, not restocked once sold.

revive.name: Revival Draught
revive.text: Brings a fallen unit back at full HP.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.text: Cures poison, in battle or on the map (poison lingers after a battle).

scroll_invisibility.name: Scroll of Invisibility
scroll_invisibility.text: For 6 hours a squad passes enemy squads unseen: they don't notice it, block it or fight it. It shows itself when it attacks or starts taking a place.

scroll_decoy.name: Scroll of Decoy
scroll_decoy.text: An enemy squad you can see marches off after a squad that isn't there, about 12 hexes away from yours, and waits there 4 hours. Works 3 times in 5; otherwise the scroll is simply spent.

scroll_teleport.name: Scroll of Teleport
scroll_teleport.text: A squad steps at once to a town, tower or temple you hold.
